statement: Vasi Yoga (a planet other than the Moon in the 12th house from the Sun) is traditionally read as carrying skillfulness, charitable inclination, learning, and a strong reputation, per Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra.
editorial_note: Reflects a widely-repeated interpretation found throughout standard Vedic astrological literature, exemplified by (not claimed as a verbatim quotation of) the cited source.
